name: DCA Pym Test Kitchen "Calculated Breakfast = E x 2 + (B + P)/T" (Scrambled Eggs, Bacon, Tots & Focaccia)
brandOrRestaurant: Pym Test Kitchen (Avengers Campus · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: The best rope-drop breakfast in Disney California Adventure: two warm scrambled eggs, smoked bacon, crispy potato bites, and soft focaccia toast with zero dairy, zero citrus, and zero spice.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Mobile-order the "Calculated Breakfast" (or Kids' Spoonful of Cereal / Cinnamon French Toast) before 10:30 AM in Avengers Campus.
watchOuts: Avoid the Cinna-Pym Toast if sensitive to heavy cinnamon-sugar syrup and fried bacon crumble toppings
